name: Ratsbane
author: vkays
description: Lucia Wererat now drops a unique short sword, Ratsbane, when killed by the player. Ratsbane deals bonus disease damage against wererats and is genuinely easier to hit them with (not a flat damage bonus like the vanilla Goblin Slayer addition -- it replaces the sword's hit-or-miss formula with one that halves the defender's effective Armor Class specifically when the target is a wererat, leaving normal combat against everything else untouched). Drops as a real world pickup next to Lucia's body, not straight to inventory. Ships its own sickly-green recolored inventory icon (mdl16_format.recolor_icon_in_place) distinct from the vanilla Short Sword.
